title: Quote collection
description: Canonical format for Alexander Bustrup's personal quote library. One file, hand-editable, machine-checkable.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last write. Maintained by tooling; safe to omit when editing by hand.

id.description: Stable identifier derived from a hash of the normalised text. Never reassigned, so permalinks survive edits to surrounding metadata.

text.description: The quotation verbatim. No enclosing quotation marks, no trailing attribution — those live in their own fields.

author.description: Attributed author, as they are normally cited.

work.description: Title of the work the quotation is drawn from, without subtitle where the subtitle adds nothing.

year.description: Year the work was published or delivered. For ancient texts, the conventional date of composition.

kind.description: Where this record entered the collection, not where the words came from.

locator.description: Page, chapter, section or timestamp, when known.

tags.description: Free-form labels, including any carried over from Goodreads.

themes.description: Controlled vocabulary, so filtering stays coherent across hundreds of quotes.

lang.description: ISO-639-1 code of the quotation as stored.

note.description: Alexander's own annotation. Shown under the quote, never mixed into the quotation itself.

verification.description: A quote collection is only as good as its attributions, so every record states how far it has actually been checked.

status.description: verified: wording confirmed against the primary text. reported: attribution is well established but the primary text was not consulted. unverified: taken on trust from an import and not independently checked. disputed: known to be commonly misattributed or paraphrased.
